LanguageData.RavenResearch_FluidAdaptation.label: [Raven] Fluid Adaptation
LanguageData.RavenResearch_FluidAdaptation.descriptio: Through studying the molecular structure and absorption pathways of Raven fluid pheromones, your colonists can now actively absorb its essence upon contact. This converts the fluid's movement speed penalty into a significant boost to movement speed and armor resilience.
